title: Exhaustive Testing — 92 Parts × Materials × Machines × Controllers
brief: 12 difficulty tiers from flat bolt plate to blisk. Cross-material (6 ISO groups per part). Cross-machine (4+ machine classes). Cross-controller (6+ dialects). Coordinate accuracy validation. Physics validation against published Sandvik/Kennametal data. 10,000+ checks.

units.title: Physics validation against Sandvik published kc1.1
units.description: For each of 6 ISO groups: verify PRISM kc1.1 ±5% of Sandvik. For 4140 at 28HRC: verify force ±10% of Sandvik charts.
exit_conditions: Physics validation against Sandvik published kc1.1 complete

units.title: S/F validation against Sandvik/Kennametal/ISCAR recommendations
units.description: For CNMG 120408 in 4140: verify Vc/fz ±15% of each manufacturer.
exit_conditions: S/F validation against Sandvik/Kennametal/ISCAR recommendations complete

units.title: Cross-material test: same part in 12 materials (milling)
units.description: Multi-pocket bracket in: 6061 Al, 7075 Al, 1045, 4140(28), 4140(42HRC), 303SS, 316L, gray CI, Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel 718, D2(62HRC), PEEK. Verify 12 DIFFERENT programs with correct physics per material.
exit_conditions: Cross-material test: same part in 12 materials (milling) complete

units.title: Cross-material test: same part in 10 materials (turning)
units.description: Stepped shaft in: 1045, 4140(28), 4140(48HRC), 303SS, 6061, Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel, 52100(60HRC), gray CI, brass. Verify 10 different programs.
exit_conditions: Cross-material test: same part in 10 materials (turning) complete

units.title: Cross-machine test: same part on 4 machine classes
units.description: Pocket plate on: Haas VF-2 (entry), DMG CMX (mid), Makino a51nx (high), Kern (ultra). Verify different toolpath complexity, different S/F profiles, different strategies.
exit_conditions: Cross-machine test: same part on 4 machine classes complete
